## Checklist

- [ ] Unity compiles with no errors and no warnings from this package.
- [ ] Every new file and folder has its `.meta`; moved files kept theirs (`git mv`); no GUID changed.
- [ ] Renamed serialised fields use `[FormerlySerializedAs]`; EditorPrefs keys are migrated.
- [ ] UI text uses the tool's own words (a mesh is a *part*, an island is a *piece*).
- [ ] Comments say why, not what; new types and members are `internal` by default.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]` (Added, Changed or Fixed) that says what users will notice. These lines become the release notes. Nothing to add? Ask for the `no-changelog` label.
- [ ] If the README changed: the translations are updated, or marked out of date.
- [ ] No file paths, user names or email addresses in code, comments or screenshots.
